<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/csv/upload"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Stores the uploaded file(s) and records each as `uploaded`. Processing/ingestion is NOT triggered here — call `POST /csv/sync` with the returned uploadIds to start it. Files are stored independently, so one bad file is reported in `failures` without sinking the rest of the batch.
